title: Warm Filipino Hind Shank Lumpia
description: Savory and creamy Filipino dish featuring hind shank, confit-tomato, and wrapped in a corn husk, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the braised hind shank to the pan and stir to combine with the onion and garlic.
Stir in the confit tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked hind shank mixture, softened cream cheese, chopped green onion, salt, and black pepper, and mix until well combined.
Lay a corn husk flat and place about 1/4 cup of the hind shank mixture in the center of the husk.
Fold the sides of the corn husk over the filling and roll up the lumpia to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining corn husks and filling.
Place the lumpia on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
